plugin.name: desktop-aside
plugin._long: Slides a screen's desktop picture, icons and windows sideways when asked through the control socket (method "desktop-aside/move"), uncovering what lies under them, while the menu bar and dock stay put. The shell uses it to open its list of notifications the way OS X 10.9 opens its Notification Center.

option.name: background_color
option._long: Painted behind the shifted desktop while it is aside, so Wayfire's own background can stay black at login.
